print(df.isnull().sum())

# Check unique values in 'site'
print("\nUnique sites:", df['site'].unique())

# Check the response variable
print("\nUnique values in 'response':", df['response'].unique())
print("Value counts in 'response':")
print(df['response'].value_counts())"}
